anchor_definition: On online rollout observations only: mean over batch AND 2 coordinates of (raw Gaussian mu_PPO - raw mu_fixed_BC)^2. No hidden normalization or rescaling. Fixed teacher uses the same serialized training-only observation normalizer; no teacher gradients or optimizer membership. Executed actions clipped to [-1,1] for physics and separate diagnostics. Anchor loss has no direct gradient to log_std or Critic.
decay_definition: Long decay: beta0 * max(0,1-max(0,online_steps-1024)/(100352-1024)); first optimization beta0, final optimization0. Fixed and decaying jobs restart from BC with identical per-seed random streams; b0 long control freshly trained once.
protocol: This is a new experiment, not a reuse of previous C results. Evaluate every new short checkpoint on7300-7399; choose eligible nonzero beta ONLY using11000-11099 zero/final scores across all3 training seeds. At most1 nonzero group chosen by mean stable success (within0.5pp use error then action cost then lower beta). Train chosen fixed+linear-decay and new beta0 control at100352 steps, 3 seeds each. If none eligible, all long jobs explicitly unexecuted. Freeze all model hashes and rule before one final12000-12099 evaluation of declared short/long models and BC/expert references. Stable success=ALL LAST FIVE steps XY distance<1cm. Rewards remain original3D distance/control1.0/1.0,250 steps,dt.02.
